object.attr: analysis: review Q48. A plain `git push` doesn't push tags, so an issue cut in Mellon can stay on one machine while the team works from the last pushed one (E57). No command is named: TEAM.md says how to push tags (handed to Process). Mellon doesn't push (MELLON-VER-SRS-373).
object.description: When Mellon creates a tag, Mellon should report that the tag stays local until the user pushes the tag.
